samples.identity: Modular commerce SDK with CommonJS lib and bundled dist outputs, declaration files, order/payment/booking modules and login solutions.
evidence: No installation execution hook; prepublishOnly builds for publishers.
Login credentials are passed to configured authentication APIs; OAuth uses Facebook and configured Apple SDK integration.
ScanOrderLogger sends explicitly configured commerce diagnostics to Feishu/Grafana providers.
Strategy engine evaluates caller-supplied rule expressions; mock-window plugin evaluates event handlers. These are SDK facilities, not a hidden payload.

False observations came from array.find on PaymentMethodType.Wallet, a comma-separated TypeScript ApplicationData import, BookingSchedule.Social enum names, refund properties and ordinary request.post calls.
samples.note: Pisell SDK 2.2.316: relocate commerce/API traits; fix file-search FPs

samples.identity: npm-hosted obfuscated Cloudflare-style redirect landing page; package.json exports only index.html.
evidence: String-array rotation and decoder wrappers recovered in an isolated QuickJS context; only decoder/rotation code executed, no network or DOM execution.
POSTs a lookup key to https://api.keyval.org/get; parses val as base64 counter:ciphertext.
Imports an embedded AES key and decrypts the destination using AES-CTR with a 128-bit counter.
Queries the decrypted host at /api/strategies/check?cid= and uses a returned redirect_url when supplied.
Forwards visitor query parameters and replaces the browser location.
CAPTCHA success, error, expiry, timeout and unsupported callbacks permit the same navigation; fallback timer redirects after one second.
No credential form in the shipped page, no install hook, no evidence that a legitimate package was trojanized. Downstream destination content was not fetched.
samples.note: ticketcathayoct12 1.0.0: require CAPTCHA failure bypass and decrypt
